name: veritas
description: Repository-local compiler and synchronizer for versioned agent steering and skills

scripts.format:check: prettier --check src tests package.json package-lock.json 'tsconfig*.json' '*.config.*' '.prettierrc.json' scripts/*.mjs
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.ts
scripts.build: node scripts/clean-build.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/finish-build.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:integration && npm run test:package
